issue: New entry does not persist across reload
actual: Added entry 'Test Entry Alpha' appeared immediately in table/card views (6 entries), but after navigating/reloading the app, state reset to the original 5 seed entries and the new field 'Notes' was also gone. localStorage/sessionStorage were empty, confirming no persistence mechanism.

evidence: Added field 'Notes' (Text type) via Fields dialog; it immediately appeared as a sortable column in table view, as a field in card view, and as a text input in the Add Entry form.
Entered text 'Test Entry Alpha', number 5, date 2026-09-10, checkbox=true; saved entry showed 'Test Entry Alpha', '5', 'Sep 10, 2026', and check icon in table, and matching values in card view.
Switching Table<->Cards preserved identical entries and field values (e.g. 6 entries with same field values in both views).

Table sorted by Task Name (descending) while Cards independently sorted by Priority (ascending); switching back to Table retained 'Sorted by Task Name (descending)', switching to Cards retained 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'.

issue: No filtering feature present in the app
actual: Full DOM scan of interactive elements (buttons/inputs) on the home screen and Fields dialog found only: Fields, Search, Sort, Table, Cards, Add Entry, field name/type inputs, Add, Close. No filter control, filter dialog, or per-field criteria UI exists anywhere in the app.

evidence: With no field sort active ('Clear sort'), used the drag-handle's keyboard sensor (Space/ArrowDown/Space) to move 'Design new landing page' from position 1 to position 3 in Table view; Card view retained its own separate default order, then a separate keyboard drag reorder in Cards moved 'Design new landing page' to the end there without affecting Table's order (verified by switching back to Table).

issue: No import feature present in the app
actual: No import button, dialog, or file-upload control exists anywhere in the app despite the Fields dialog note stating 'Configure fields before importing data.' Full DOM scan found no import-related control.

evidence: Priority field is a native input[type=number]; Playwright refused to type 'abc' into it ('Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), and pressing the 'a' key while focused left the value unchanged at '0', confirming non-numeric input is rejected.

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]; programmatically setting an invalid date string '2026-13-45' resulted in the field value being rejected and reset to empty string, while a valid date '2026-10-05' was accepted normally.
Sorting by Task Name (asc/desc) and by Priority kept entry count at 5 throughout and all field values (Priority, Due Date) remained attached to their correct entries, only row order changed.

actual: No filter UI exists in the app (see FT-6), so filter-criteria matching and restore-on-clear behavior cannot be exercised.

evidence: All 4-5 fields for every entry displayed identically in Table and Card views (same text/number/date/checkbox values); the empty 'Notes' field for seed entries was shown as a clear em-dash '—' placeholder in both views.

Fields dialog type selector clearly lists 'Text', 'Number', 'Date', 'Checkbox' labels; Add Entry form renders a textbox for text, a spinbutton (input[type=number]) for number, a date picker (input[type=date]) for date, and a checkbox toggle with 'Yes'/'No' label for checkbox.

Table view shows a green 'check' icon for true and a muted 'x' icon for false; Card view and entry form show explicit 'Yes'/'No' text labels alongside the checkbox — clearly distinguishable in both data views and the form.

issue: Quick search matches raw internal values instead of displayed formatted values
actual: Searching 'Jan 15' (the displayed due-date text) returned '0 entries matching', while searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-15' returned 1 match. Searching 'Yes' (the displayed checkbox label) returned '0 entries matching' despite two entries having a true/'Yes' checkbox value.

evidence: Typing lowercase 'review' matched 'Review marketing materials' (case-insensitive substring), status bar updated to '1 entry matching \"review\"', and clicking the clear button restored the count to '5 entries' with all entries visible.

Clicking the Task Name column header immediately reordered entries alphabetically ascending and status bar showed 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending)'; clicking again showed '(descending)' with reversed order; app remained fully interactive throughout.
